entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: People in the city are all pretty terrible,[n]but it's hard finding someone with a[n]Palace...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you want to make some infiltration[n]tools, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just gather the [clr 2]materials[clr 27] in the Metaverse,[n]then I'll help you[n]make them!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Don't talk to me while I'm working.[n]You don't want me to mess up, do you?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Aren't you going to sleep yet?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I will be fine here. I sleep in my studio[n]on occasion, so this is luxurious in[n]comparison.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I enjoy going to a bathhouse every[n]once in a while. The hot water is[n]quite relaxing.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's my fault...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All this happened because I kept the[n]calling card...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's so late already...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Is Sojiro still awake?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This is kind of awkward...
Go home or he'll worry.
You can sleep on the sofa.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wait, shouldn't you sleep on the sofa,[n]so that Futaba can go ahead and sleep[n]on the bed?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...I'm gonna go home.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Night.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Remember how I hijacked your phone[n]during the school trip? That kinda came[n]in handy!
How so?
I'm not interested.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh, you wanna hear it again?
Definitely.
Not now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Well, remember how I put that wiretap[n]app in Akechi's phone?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Basically that let me see GPS info for[n]two phones: yours and his.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'd be able to tell the precise moment[n]Sae Niijima, who had your phone,[n]ran into Akechi!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's when I saw my chance and beep—[n]sent the signal to activate the Metaverse[n]Navigator.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But there was the chance they'd just[n]pass each other without saying a[n]single word.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's why we needed you to tell Sae[n]Niijima to show the phone to Akechi!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This plan still surprises me no matter[n]how many times I hear it...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Still, I couldn't just directly hack into[n]the Metaverse Nav. It's a mysterious[n]app, after all.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But you know how it has that bookmark[n]function? All you have to do is push the[n]button.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Making the phone think he was pushing[n]that button was totally doable.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mwehehehe... Pretty good, huh!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whattt? That's no fun.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: [fName] is tired. You can tell[n]him some other time, okay?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It may not have looked like it, but[n]everyone else was risking their lives too.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Though there's no doubt you were the[n]most at risk. I mean, you actually got[n]arrested.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...But it seems like all the drugs and stuff[n]made you forget the details of the plan.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Want me to explain how it all went[n]down? It might take a bit.
Definitely.
Not now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Well, since the rest of us didn't get[n]captured, we had to act.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We had to pretend we never wanted[n]you to get arrested... Pretend the[n]suicide news was a real shock...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Basically, we had to act like we didn't[n]know anything, 24/7.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The enemy knows who we are, so we[n]couldn't let our guard down even once[n]while you were gone.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If they had people watching us and[n]realized what our plan was, they[n]would have killed you immediately.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Wanna hear more?
I do.
That's enough for now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Another tough part was figuring out[n]how to get Sae Niijima and Akechi[n]back from the Metaverse.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: In order to return to reality, you have to[n]go back to the point where you came[n]into the Metaverse.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So, Sae and Akechi had to go through[n]where the Nav was activated, as in...[n]the hall where they met.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Akechi would just come back the same[n]way after the assassination. The real[n]issue was Sae Niijima.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We needed to stop her for a moment[n]before she headed back toward the[n]interrogation room.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But nothing can be sent to a phone[n]inside a Palace. So... I had to program[n]the messages in beforehand.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: In doing so, I made it seem like the[n]messages were coming at that exact[n]moment in time.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That part was kinda last minute, so I[n]had to pull an all-nighter trying to[n]get it set up...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...I'm really on a roll here! Wanna hear[n]some more?
Yes, please.
That's enough, I think.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Lemme see, another problematic[n]thing was...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh yeah! Tying Akechi up! That was[n]really tough...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Uhhh, I obviously don't mean the[n]real Akechi. Even if we could do that,[n]it would ruin our plan.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The one we had to tie up was Sae[n]Niijima's cognitive Akechi.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...This part's really complicated. I know[n]you're tired. You sure you wanna hear[n]all of this now?
Definitely.
Actually, maybe not.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Well, we needed to lure Akechi into[n]Sae Niijima's Palace and have him kill[n]the cognitive [fName].

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But Akechi would have entered the[n]Palace immediately after meeting[n]Sae Niijima in the hallway, right?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Because of that, there was a pretty[n]decent chance he'd run into the[n]cognitive Akechi.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And if that happened, Akechi would've[n]totally realized we'd lured him into[n]the Palace.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Nobody actually even thought of this[n]possibility until the night before the[n]assassination...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Makoto realized in the middle of the[n]night, then it was a huge mess trying[n]to figure out what to do.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: In the end, we chose to sneak into[n]the Metaverse while the plan was[n]happening to tie up the cognition.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Because you told Sae to show him[n]the phone, we expected her to chat[n]with him for at least a bit...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So, we had a few minutes to strike after[n]the cognitive Akechi showed up, but[n]before the Nav activated.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It was Operation: Tie Him Up! Though[n]it wasn't really much of an operation[n]in the end...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Thankfully, Sae Niijima didn't know[n]his true nature, so the one that[n]appeared was an ordinary kid.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It was pretty simple surrounding him,[n]knocking him out, and tossing him on[n]another floor.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But man, watching Makoto's skill was[n]super amazing... I guess she does use[n]knuckles as her weapon...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Basically what I'm trying to say is,[n]appreciate what everyone else did.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Phew. I just can't help but rant when[n]I'm talking about stuff that interests me.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sorry 'bout that. Just focus on resting[n]up. You don't have to worry about[n]anything else.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And seriously... well done,[n][fName].

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I guess that's understandable.[n]You must be pretty exhausted.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Just focus on resting up. You don't[n]have to worry about anything else.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And seriously...[n]well done, [fName].

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, by the way...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: The police report on your death isn't[n]gonna show up at your school. No[n]need to worry.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Seems Prosecutor Niijima worked out[n]some kinda deal with the higher-ups[n]or something.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I mean, they haven't even said anything[n]to me even. As long as you stay quiet,[n]you'll be fine.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: And I guess if they reported your death[n]now, they'd basically be saying you[n]were a phantom thief.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: They can't really go announcing what[n]the Phantom Thieves are, so I'm sure[n]they'll avoid that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: At any rate... I'm glad you're back safe[n]and sound.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But even that's putting it too lightly.[n]You had it rough in there, didn't you?
Don't worry about it.
Only a little.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Akechi was after you all along. I knew[n]it was risky, but we had no choice but[n]to depend on him.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But thanks to your tenacity, you were[n]able to fool him.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's payback time. Let's make him regret[n]underestimating the Phantom Thieves!
